name: Miraval Austin Resort & Spa
positioning: Adults-only, device-free wellness resort in the Balcones Canyonlands Preserve in the Texas Hill Country, with an inclusive, gratuity-free package
best_for: Adults seeking a spa and wellness retreat they don't have to leave
Couples who want a shared spa experience
Travelers who want to unplug from their devices

facts.text: Miraval Austin is located in the Balcones Canyonlands Preserve in the Texas Hill Country.
Of the resort's 220-plus acres, 170 will never be developed.
Architects, designers and chefs chose each detail in alignment with the culture of Austin, Texas.
Rooms include meditation cushions, singing Tibetan bowls, plush robes and slippers.
The spa entryway is lined with stone walls, wood-beamed ceilings and mandalas.
The property has two infinity pools.
The amenities include an equine center, cooking and cocktail classes, and an onsite farm.
A guided Preserve Hike covers two miles in the Balcones Canyonlands Preserve with 250 feet of elevation gain.
Packages include all meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies and non-alcoholic beverages.
Packages include a shared shuttle from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.

highlights.text: All rooms have private balconies with Hill Country views, and some overlook Lake Travis.
Endangered golden-cheeked warblers nest on the property each year.
Tidal Flow, a couples aquatic journey, is a spa treatment exclusive to Miraval Austin.
The on-site Cypress Creek Farm provides produce and eggs for guests' meals.
Quantum Leap on the Blue Heron Challenge Course is a leap from a 25-foot pole.

considerations.text: Miraval welcomes guests who are 18 or older.
Miraval is a digital device-free environment.
The resort is not a jumping-off point to explore Austin; guests come and stay. Spa appointments fill up quickly, and 4-6 week advance reservations are strongly recommended.
